title: My Half-Brother Forged Dad's Will, Sold Our Rink, And Sent Me $4,500. So I Voided The Sale
description: At 58, after 26 years as a school cafeteria monitor, I came home to care for Dad and found my half-brother Marty forged a codicil cutting me out of the family roller rink. The real will was hidden inside a hollow rental skate, so the $840,000 sale was voided and now Marty polishes skates while every ticket prints his probate-fraud docket. #InheritanceFraud #FamilyBetrayal #RollerRinkRevenge
thumb_text: I FOUND DAD'S REAL WILL IN A SKATE
pinned_comment: If my half-brother forged a codicil, sold Dad's rink for $840,000, and mailed me a $4,500 'skate lace' check, what would you do the moment you found the real will inside a rental skate? Share your story in the comments.
